hero_eyebrow: Free to start · Runs in your browser · Nothing is uploaded
hero_lead: Cut any audio file down to the part you need. Nothing is uploaded — the trim happens locally and you download a ready .wav file.
drop_sub: or click to browse · MP3, WAV, M4A, OGG
decode_error: Couldn't read this audio file. Try a different format.
trim_error: Something went wrong while trimming. Please try again.
footnote: Output is a .wav file. Original quality is preserved — no re-compression.
how_title: Three steps to a trimmed clip
how_lead: No settings to configure. Drop a file, pick a range, download.
step1_desc: Drag and drop, or choose from your device. Your file never leaves it.
step2_desc: Drag the start and end handles to the part you want to keep.
step3_desc: Get a trimmed .wav file in one click, ready to use anywhere.
